index: Consumer Price Index, total quarterly index, Department of Statistics (STAT) Sint Maarten
note: Quarterly: each year's mean is of its four quarters (2025's, 114.905, is the department's own average CPI for 2025, 114.90). The World Bank's 2021 level is in Netherlands Antillean guilders; the Caribbean guilder replaced the guilder on 31 March 2025 at one for one, so the level stands in Caribbean guilders unchanged.

sources.title: Department of Statistics (STAT) Sint Maarten, Inflation: Consumer Price Index, Total Quarterly Index
Government of Sint Maarten, Consumer Price Index Increased in the Fourth Quarter of 2025
sources.said: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) increased in the fourth quarter of 2025 to 115.28, which represented an increase of 0.16% when compared to the previous quarter. ... The total average CPI for 2025 is 114.90. The inflation for 2025 is 0.92%

sources.title: Curaçao Chronicle, Launch of Caribbean guilder on March 31, 2025 (quoting the Centrale Bank van Curaçao en Sint Maarten, whose site answers with a Cloudflare challenge)
sources.said: the new currency will change from ANG to XCG. "The change in the currency unit will not affect its value, 1 ANG will remain equal to 1 XCG," stated CBCS.
